purpose: Promote the existing lane-depth public scaffolds into one audited public-explainer completion layer for all 15 analytical lanes, without completing current-law, source-custody, floor-value, policy-scenario, transition, solver, receipt/rate, savings, or balanced-budget gates.

template_answers.what_it_does: Pays federal health commitments and separates Medicare, Medicaid, subsidies, public health, private-price context, and access obligations before any federal budget conclusion.
template_answers.what_taxpayers_pay_now: Current public-facing amounts remain context only until official FY2025-FY2035 component federal paths are complete.
template_answers.who_is_served_or_protected: Medicare beneficiaries, Medicaid and CHIP beneficiaries, subsidized households, public-health beneficiaries, providers needed for access, and taxpayers.
template_answers.outcomes: Coverage, access, quality, risk-adjusted outcomes, safety-net capacity, equity, resilience, and delivery feasibility.
template_answers.overspending_underfunding_boundary: Price or volume pressure is a review signal, not gross savings, net savings, a target cost, or a Medicare/Medicaid cut instruction.
template_answers.technology_transition: Administrative simplification and care-delivery tools need transition cost, cyber, workforce, enforcement, provider, and beneficiary-access modeling.
template_answers.evidence_gaps: Component current-law path, federal policy score, behavior, incidence, transition/admin cost, and floor-value evidence.
template_answers.blocked_claims: Rates, savings, waste or fraud findings, department cuts, technology savings, solver outputs, and balanced-budget claims.

template_answers.what_it_does: Pays earned retirement, disability, and survivor benefits through the separate OASDI trust-fund framework.
template_answers.what_taxpayers_pay_now: Current public amounts remain blocked until OASDI receipts, outgo, trust-fund balance, transfers, taxable payroll, and 75-year solvency are captured.
template_answers.who_is_served_or_protected: Retired workers, disabled workers, survivors, dependents, near-retirees, current contributors, and beneficiaries protected by adequacy floors.
template_answers.outcomes: Replacement adequacy, old-age poverty, disability and survivor protection, intergenerational fairness, solvency, and administrability.
template_answers.overspending_underfunding_boundary: A shortfall or peer difference is a solvency and adequacy review signal, not a benefit-cut instruction or payroll-rate calculation.
template_answers.technology_transition: Claims processing, earnings records, identity, appeals, fraud controls, cyber, and service channels must be costed before modernization credit.
template_answers.evidence_gaps: Official 75-year trust-fund path, taxable wage-base evidence, formula and eligibility levers, adequacy values, and incidence review.
template_answers.blocked_claims: Rates, savings, benefit cuts, solver outputs, technology savings, and balanced-budget claims.

template_answers.what_it_does: Funds defense commitments, force structure, readiness, personnel, operations, procurement, research, and strategic capacity.
template_answers.what_taxpayers_pay_now: Current amounts remain blocked until multiyear defense path, force structure, readiness, procurement schedule, and GDP-band context are sourced.
template_answers.who_is_served_or_protected: The public, service members, allies under commitments, defense civilians, mission-critical contractors, and future taxpayers.
template_answers.outcomes: Treaty commitments, readiness, personnel safety, force structure, procurement schedule, strategic reserve, and industrial-base resilience.
template_answers.overspending_underfunding_boundary: Procurement or audit findings are management review signals, not automatic savings, waste findings, fraud findings, or readiness cuts.
template_answers.technology_transition: Modernization, autonomy, cyber, procurement reform, sustainment, training, and industrial-base shifts require transition and readiness modeling.
template_answers.evidence_gaps: Multiyear baseline, force-structure plan, readiness floor evidence, procurement schedule, transition cost, and score provenance.
template_answers.blocked_claims: Department cuts, savings, waste or fraud findings, technology savings, solver outputs, rates, and balanced-budget claims.

template_answers.what_it_does: Covers income support, family supports, childcare, nutrition handoffs, work supports, and poverty-reduction commitments.
template_answers.what_taxpayers_pay_now: Current values remain partial context until benefit package, take-up, and federal/state/local translation paths are complete.
template_answers.who_is_served_or_protected: Children, families, low-income households, workers in transition, caregivers, state and local delivery partners, and taxpayers.
template_answers.outcomes: Child poverty, food hardship, childcare access, work transition, benefit adequacy, family stability, and administrative access.
template_answers.overspending_underfunding_boundary: Take-up gaps, payment gaps, or peer differences are review signals, not savings, cuts, or fraud findings.
template_answers.technology_transition: Eligibility, enrollment, verification, payment, appeals, data matching, and service delivery require due-process and access transition costs.
template_answers.evidence_gaps: CBO, Census, HHS/ACF, USDA, take-up, floor-value, and federal/state/local translation evidence.
template_answers.blocked_claims: Savings, department cuts, technology savings, solver outputs, rates, and balanced-budget claims.

template_answers.what_it_does: Supports education access, student aid, workforce training, employment services, and federal/state/local education-workforce commitments.
template_answers.what_taxpayers_pay_now: Current values remain FY2025 context only until federal/state/local translation and annual path evidence are complete.
template_answers.who_is_served_or_protected: Students, workers, trainees, borrowers, institutions, employers, states, local systems, and taxpayers.
template_answers.outcomes: Attainment, completion, access, employment, earnings, equity, borrower protection, and training effectiveness.
template_answers.overspending_underfunding_boundary: Weak completion or earnings evidence is a policy review signal, not automatic savings or program cancellation.
template_answers.technology_transition: Digital services, training tools, data systems, student aid operations, privacy, and institution transitions require cost and access review.
template_answers.evidence_gaps: Federal/state/local translation, annual paths, outcome floor values, service transition, and policy score provenance.
template_answers.blocked_claims: Target cost, savings, rate cards, solver outputs, technology savings, and balanced-budget claims.

template_answers.what_it_does: Funds veterans benefits, health care, disability compensation, pensions, education, housing, claims processing, and statutory service commitments.
template_answers.what_taxpayers_pay_now: Current values remain FY2025 context until eligible-cohort, service-package, claims-timeliness, and annual path evidence are complete.
template_answers.who_is_served_or_protected: Veterans, disabled veterans, survivors, caregivers, eligible dependents, health-system users, and taxpayers.
template_answers.outcomes: Statutory continuity, access, health outcomes, housing stability, claims timeliness, appeals fairness, and service quality.
template_answers.overspending_underfunding_boundary: Claims delays or service gaps are accountability signals, not savings estimates or benefit-cut instructions.
template_answers.technology_transition: Claims modernization, health delivery, scheduling, records, appeals, identity, privacy, and access risks require transition modeling.
template_answers.evidence_gaps: Eligible-cohort path, service-package path, claims timeliness, statutory continuity, access, health, and housing floor values.
template_answers.blocked_claims: Target cost, savings, department cuts, technology savings, solver outputs, rates, and balanced-budget claims.

template_answers.what_it_does: Covers disaster response, mitigation, recovery, resilience, reserves, and exposure-linked public protection.
template_answers.what_taxpayers_pay_now: Current values remain FY2025 context until exposure-normalized paths, reserve paths, and annual values are complete.
template_answers.who_is_served_or_protected: Disaster survivors, exposed communities, state and local partners, infrastructure users, emergency responders, and taxpayers.
template_answers.outcomes: Mitigation, recovery speed, service continuity, loss reduction, equity, resilience, and fiscal reserve adequacy.
template_answers.overspending_underfunding_boundary: Disaster spending spikes or mitigation gaps are exposure and reserve review signals, not avoided-loss savings.
template_answers.technology_transition: Mapping, forecasting, claims, grants, inspection, cyber, emergency communications, and response tools require transition and continuity costs.
template_answers.evidence_gaps: Exposure-normalized loss model, reserve path, mitigation values, recovery values, service continuity values, and policy score provenance.
template_answers.blocked_claims: Avoided-loss savings, target cost, solver output, rate cards, technology savings, and balanced-budget claims.

template_answers.what_it_does: Covers federal justice, courts, public safety, law enforcement, corrections, rights protection, and intergovernmental justice commitments.
template_answers.what_taxpayers_pay_now: Current values remain FY2025 context until federalism, caseload, court-process, and annual path evidence are complete.
template_answers.who_is_served_or_protected: The public, defendants, victims, litigants, detained people, law enforcement, courts, state and local partners, and taxpayers.
template_answers.outcomes: Due process, safety, rights protection, timeliness, access to courts, caseload capacity, and federalism integrity.
template_answers.overspending_underfunding_boundary: Caseload pressure or process delay is a service and rights signal, not an automatic cut or savings estimate.
template_answers.technology_transition: Court systems, case management, data sharing, privacy, cyber, evidence systems, and service access require transition and rights review.
template_answers.evidence_gaps: Federalism path, caseload path, court process values, rights, safety, timeliness, and due-process floor evidence.
template_answers.blocked_claims: Target cost, savings, department cuts, solver output, rate cards, technology savings, and balanced-budget claims.

template_answers.what_it_does: Covers science, energy, environmental protection, research, infrastructure resilience, reliability, air quality, ecosystems, and innovation capacity.
template_answers.what_taxpayers_pay_now: Current values remain FY2025 context until separate science, energy, and environment component paths are complete.
template_answers.who_is_served_or_protected: Researchers, energy users, communities affected by pollution or reliability, ecosystems, industry partners, and taxpayers.
template_answers.outcomes: Research continuity, grid reliability, air quality, ecosystem protection, innovation lag, safety, and component-specific performance.
template_answers.overspending_underfunding_boundary: A composite peer difference is not a target; component gaps must be reviewed separately before any policy scenario.
template_answers.technology_transition: Innovation, grid, environmental monitoring, permitting, cyber, and deployment changes require lag, reliability, and implementation-cost modeling.
template_answers.evidence_gaps: Separate component annual paths, component scenarios, component thresholds and values, transition model, and solver component mapping.
template_answers.blocked_claims: Composite target, savings, rate cards, solver output, technology savings, and balanced-budget claims.

template_answers.what_it_does: Covers farm support, crop insurance, agricultural services, market-price support boundaries, and nutrition handoff protections.
template_answers.what_taxpayers_pay_now: Current values remain FY2025 context until support, insurance, services, market-price-support, and nutrition-handoff paths are separated.
template_answers.who_is_served_or_protected: Farmers, ranchers, rural communities, food-system users, nutrition program participants through handoffs, insurers, and taxpayers.
template_answers.outcomes: Farm resilience, productivity, food security, environmental outcomes, market stability, program integrity, and service access.
template_answers.overspending_underfunding_boundary: Crop-insurance or support differences are review signals, not fraud findings, savings, or nutrition cuts.
template_answers.technology_transition: Insurance, claims, conservation, market, risk, data, and service delivery tools require transition, false-positive, and access review.
template_answers.evidence_gaps: Separated component paths, nutrition double-count prevention, floor values, insurance/service transition, and solver mapping.
template_answers.blocked_claims: Crop-insurance fraud inference, savings, target cost, solver output, rate cards, technology savings, and balanced-budget claims.

template_answers.what_it_does: Covers diplomacy, ODA/development, humanitarian assistance, security assistance, exchanges, and financial instruments.
template_answers.what_taxpayers_pay_now: Current values remain FY2025 context until component commitment-to-outlay bridges and annual paths are complete.
template_answers.who_is_served_or_protected: The public, diplomatic personnel, partner countries, humanitarian beneficiaries, security partners, exchange participants, and taxpayers.
template_answers.outcomes: Diplomatic capacity, humanitarian effectiveness, development outcomes, security commitments, exchange value, and financial-instrument fiscal risk.
template_answers.overspending_underfunding_boundary: Mixed GDP comparisons or negative financial-program outlays are not targets or savings without component treatment.
template_answers.technology_transition: Program delivery, monitoring, cyber, financial-risk systems, partner capacity, and security controls require component transition modeling.
template_answers.evidence_gaps: Diplomacy, ODA, humanitarian, security, exchange, and financial-instrument scenarios plus commitment-to-outlay bridges.
template_answers.blocked_claims: Mixed GDP comparison targets, savings, solver output, rate cards, technology savings, and balanced-budget claims.

template_answers.what_it_does: Covers transportation, infrastructure, trust-fund accounting, federal outlay paths, modernization contracts, and service floor indicators.
template_answers.what_taxpayers_pay_now: Current values remain partial until FY2032-FY2035 baseline years and trust-fund annual values are complete.
template_answers.who_is_served_or_protected: Infrastructure users, communities, states, transit and highway beneficiaries, freight users, safety stakeholders, and taxpayers.
template_answers.outcomes: Asset condition, safety, access, reliability, state/local delivery, trust-fund continuity, resilience, and service continuity.
template_answers.overspending_underfunding_boundary: Pilot depth is not a simulator result; missing years, trust-fund values, and floors block savings or rate claims.
template_answers.technology_transition: Modernization needs implementation, procurement, cyber, workforce, state/local adoption, fallback, and productivity evidence before credit.
template_answers.evidence_gaps: FY2032-FY2035 baseline, trust-fund annual values, floor thresholds, policy values, stress values, and receipt/rate bridge.
template_answers.blocked_claims: Simulator output, rates, savings, department cuts, technology savings, and balanced-budget claims.

template_answers.what_it_does: Defines receipt bases, legal and economic perimeters, incidence, distribution, behavior, administration, yields, and interactions for later solvency tests.
template_answers.what_taxpayers_pay_now: Current amounts and rates remain blocked until matched receipt bases and current-law/reform yields are complete.
template_answers.who_is_served_or_protected: Taxpayers, employers, administrators, households affected by incidence, and programs relying on general-fund financing.
template_answers.outcomes: Solvency, distribution, growth, compliance, administrative burden, taxpayer burden, and interaction integrity.
template_answers.overspending_underfunding_boundary: Revenue solvency is non-additive and cannot identify department overspending by itself.
template_answers.technology_transition: Filing, compliance, audit, and administration tools require implementation cost, burden, avoidance, incidence, and distribution modeling.
template_answers.evidence_gaps: Matched bases, elasticity, avoidance/compliance, distribution, incidence, administration, interactions, current-law yield, and reform yield.
template_answers.blocked_claims: Statutory rates, effective rates, tax proposal, public rate cards, savings, solver outputs, and balanced-budget claims.

template_answers.what_it_does: Separates improper-payment measurement, confirmed fraud, debt establishment, collections, prevention, control cost, and net savings.
template_answers.what_taxpayers_pay_now: Current values remain context only; no savings score exists without causal prevention or same-cohort collection lineage.
template_answers.who_is_served_or_protected: Beneficiaries, providers, agencies, auditors, taxpayers, and parties affected by eligibility, documentation, appeals, and collections.
template_answers.outcomes: Due process, false positives, access, timeliness, recoverability, control cost, service risk, and same-cohort outcomes.
template_answers.overspending_underfunding_boundary: Improper payments are not fraud, recoverable dollars, collected recoveries, or net savings.
template_answers.technology_transition: Eligibility checks, anomaly detection, documentation, recovery, and claims tools require false-positive, access, appeal, due-process, and control-cost modeling.
template_answers.evidence_gaps: Same-cohort lineage, final classification, established debt, appeals, collectibility, cash collections, prevention attribution, and control cost.
template_answers.blocked_claims: Fraud inference, waste finding, recoverable savings, net savings, solver credit, technology savings, and balanced-budget claims.

template_answers.what_it_does: Defines net interest as an endogenous result of debt, deficits, maturity buckets, rates, interest receipts, and other financing.
template_answers.what_taxpayers_pay_now: Current values remain blocked until debt stock, maturity schedule, rate path, and baseline net-interest custody are complete.
template_answers.who_is_served_or_protected: Taxpayers, Treasury financing operations, trust funds, and every lane whose primary-balance changes affect debt and future interest.
template_answers.outcomes: Full and timely debt service, debt-stock accuracy, maturity treatment, rate-path integrity, financing consistency, and feedback correctness.
template_answers.overspending_underfunding_boundary: Net interest cannot be cut directly; it changes only through primary balance, debt, maturity, rates, and financing formulas.
template_answers.technology_transition: Forecasting or administrative tools do not create direct interest savings; effects must pass through the explicit feedback fixture.
template_answers.evidence_gaps: Official debt stock, maturity buckets, effective rates, new borrowing timing, interest receipts, other financing, and primary-balance feedback fixture.
template_answers.blocked_claims: Direct cuts, direct savings, solver output, rate cards, technology savings, and balanced-budget claims.

plain_english_status: Wave C is done for the public-explainer gate: all 15 analytical lanes now have a completion-template explainer. This does not complete lane depth, current-law paths, source custody, floor values, policy scenarios, transition models, solver mapping, receipt/rate bridges, savings, rates, or balanced-budget claims.
